messages:
maya: Rolling canary for v2.14 starting now (change window). Quick preflight: can people eyeball SLO dashboards and confirm no existing alerts? I'll kick off deploy in 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started change window — canary 1/10 -> traffic 10% -> route=canary-v2.14

sam: Checking p95 for embed-service and generation-api. p95 embed ~180ms baseline. No alerts in last 30m.

ria: Seeing a small uptick in rerank-worker errors in eu-west — ~0.6% 5xx last 5m (baseline 0.1%). Opening a trace.

ops-jen: Thanks — which route / example trace id?

ria: trace id: trace-9a3f. Stack shows GRPC DeadlineExceeded calling kvcache -> redis. Suspect GC + quantize client timeout interaction.

maya: Ok. Don't roll back yet. Plan: pin canary, reduce traffic to 2%, enable fallback model on errors, and increase kvcache client timeout as a stopgap.

sam: On it. Reducing traffic now: `deployctl traffic set canary-v2.14 2% --thread 6842001234`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic change accepted -> canary now 2%

ria: Muting alert rule `rerank-5xx-eu` for 10m to avoid noisy paging while we validate.

ops-jen: :thumbsup: Can someone spin up a temporary SLO monitor for p95 + error-rate for the next 15m? I can wire a dashboard quickly.

maya: Please. Rollback rule: if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m we rollback. If not, we'll ramp after 15m to 10% then 50% then 100%.

sam: Temp monitor created: https://redwood.obsv/dashboards/temp/6842001234 — watching p95 & 5xx.

ria: Found repeated deadline at kvcache client -> redis. Pushing PR to bump client timeout + add a short retry. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4321

maya: Good. If PR lands and metrics normalize within 15m we resume ramp. Otherwise rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary health checks: OK so far. Alerts suppressed: rerank-5xx-eu (muted by ria for 10m).

ops-jen: Logging decision in release notes: 'Canary reduced to 2% and fallback enabled while investigating kvcache timeouts. Temporary alert mute on rerank-5xx-eu. Rollback threshold: >1% 5xx sustained for 5m.'

maya: Thanks team — keeping eyes on the dashboard. Ping here if anything changes.
